stem:
All legislative Powers herein granted shall be vested in a Congress of the United States. . . .  
—U.S. Constitution, Article I, Section 1

This provision is a response to which grievance from the Declaration of Independence?

options.label: A
options.text: “For suspending our own Legislatures, and declaring themselves invested with power to legislate for us in all cases whatsoever . . .”

options.label: B
options.text: “For abolishing the free System of English Laws in a neighbouring Province, establishing therein an Arbitrary government . . .”

options.label: C
options.text: “He has called together legislative bodies at places unusual, uncomfortable, and distant from the depository of their public Records.”

options.label: D
options.text: “He has endeavoured to prevent the population of these States; for that purpose obstructing the Laws for Naturalization of Foreigners.”
